instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures two men in profile inside a brightly lit office with a bookshelf. On the left, the man in the grey suit (R2) stands facing right, smiling warmly as he shakes hands with the man in the red sweater (R1). Standing on the right, the man in the red sweater (R1) faces left, clasping R2's hand while placing his right hand affectionately on R2's shoulder. Soft, warm indoor light illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows.
